hooks.prompt:
For user story files:
- Auto-increment: Find highest US-XXX in high-level-user-stories.md, use next number
- Naming: us-XXX-short-name.md (lowercase filename)
- Display: US-XXX (uppercase in tables/text)

For plan files:
- Match: Use same US-XXX number as corresponding user story
- Naming: us-XXX-plan.md (lowercase filename)
- Display: US-XXX (uppercase in tables/text)

After creating user story:
1. Update high-level-user-stories.md table with new entry
2. Update Overview counts

After creating plan:
1. Link plan in high-level-user-stories.md Plan column
2. Update Overview counts if needed
